status: Exploratory follow-up defined after inspecting the earlier failed study; no untouched validation
signal: Unchanged closed-bar Supertrend 2.5/10; next-open entry; ATR14 stop 1.5 and target 2

definitions.range_avoid: Exclude long above 80% or short below 20% of prior closed 24h/7d high-low range; include signal close for location only, not range bounds; exclude closes outside that range too
definitions.room: Prior range extreme in trade direction must be at least 2 signal ATR from signal close; breakouts outside range rejected; next-open gap checked again
definitions.trend_ema200: Long above rising EMA200, short below falling EMA200; slope over 4 closed 15m bars
definitions.trend_4h_ema50: Same rule using only completed UTC 4h bars and EMA50 with 1-bar slope
definitions.atr_covers_fees: Gross 2 ATR target at signal close at least 3 times estimated round-trip commission plus market slippage; next-open economics checked again
definitions.combinations: range_and_trend uses24h range and EMA200; room_and_trend uses24h room and EMA200
definitions.breakout_24h: Long close exceeds prior24h high or short close below prior24h low; counter-hypothesis to fading range extremes

execution: Filtered opposite signal still closes old position next open; rejected new direction stays flat. Same exits for all comparisons. No screenshot fixed levels or retrospective pivots. 0.1 BTC fixed primary size to avoid most capital blocking; report capital skips. Original1 BTC comparison retained separately.
periods: Jan-Jun development; Jul-Aug comparison; September historical review, each independent100k account
costs: 0.07% each side, tick0.1/slippage2ticks, supplied historical funding using5m last-price proxy; stress0.1% fee and20tick slippage separately
selection: Development only: >=30 trades, positive net, PF>=1.1 and drawdown<=unfiltered. No qualification means no selection. All filters and stresses published, no parameter search.
diagnostics: Compare accepted and rejected unfiltered executed trades by signal timestamp, net expectancy, win rate and fees; diagnostics are conditional and not causal attribution. Counts of all signal accept/reject reported separately from capital skips.
limits: Prior BTC periods inspected. Python execution not Pine verified.5m stop-first ties. Source exchange Binance proxy not Bitunix. Thresholds are hypotheses, not optimized settings. No claim these exhaust all options.
